data.standardized_narrative: For the 2019 financial year, Syndicate 6123 experienced a gross reserve strengthening of $12.316 million, representing 16.93% of its opening gross reserves. This adverse development was primarily driven by natural catastrophe events, specifically Hurricanes Harvey and Irma impacting the 2017 underwriting year, and Hurricanes Michael and Florence impacting the 2018 underwriting year. The syndicate's loss ratios for these prior years reflected the material natural catastrophe exposure.
raw_causal_phrases: The SPA has material natural catastrophe exposure and hence the loss ratios particularly reflect the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma to the 2017 calendar year (impacting the 2017 year of account) and Hurricanes Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year (impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount derived from gross claims development table on page 17, as no explicit gross prior year development figure or narrative was found. The syndicate only reinsures properties in the U.S.
